sources.query: SELECT INTEGRATION_ID, X_CUSTOM, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, LINE_AMT, CANCELLED_LINE_AMT, CANCELLED_LINE_QTY, REQUESTED_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, PO_APPROVED_ON_DT, PO_SUBMIT_ON_DT, PO_CREATION_METHOD_ID, PO_REVISIONS, DELETE_FLG, POH_PO_HEADER_ID, POL_PO_LINE_ID, PORH_REQUISITION_HEADER_ID FROM POC.W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_FS

SELECT TO_CHAR(PRL.REQUISITION_LINE_ID) AS INTEGRATION_ID, '0' AS X_CUSTOM, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, CASE WHEN PRL.MATCHING_BASIS = 'AMOUNT' THEN PRL.AMOUNT ELSE NVL(PRL.CURRENCY_UNIT_PRICE, PRL.UNIT_PRICE) * PRL.QUANTITY END AS LINE_AMT, CASE WHEN PRL.MATCHING_BASIS = 'AMOUNT' THEN NULL ELSE NVL(PRL.CURRENCY_UNIT_PRICE, PRL.UNIT_PRICE) * PRL.QUANTITY_CANCELLED END AS CANCELLED_LINE_AMT, PRL.QUANTITY_CANCELLED AS CANCELLED_LINE_QTY, PRL.QUANTITY AS REQUESTED_QTY, NVL(PRL.CURRENCY_UNIT_PRICE, PRL.UNIT_PRICE) AS UNIT_PRICE, CASE WHEN PLL.APPROVED_FLAG = 'Y' THEN PLL.APPROVED_DATE ELSE NULL END AS PO_APPROVED_ON_DT, CASE WHEN PLL.PO_RELEASE_ID IS NULL THEN POH.SUBMIT_DATE ELSE POR.SUBMIT_DATE END AS PO_SUBMIT_ON_DT, CASE WHEN PLL.PO_RELEASE_ID IS NULL THEN POH.DOCUMENT_CREATION_METHOD ELSE POR.DOCUMENT_CREATION_METHOD END AS PO_CREATION_METHOD_ID, CASE WHEN PLL.PO_RELEASE_ID IS NULL THEN POH.REVISION_NUM ELSE POR.REVISION_NUM END AS PO_REVISIONS, CASE WHEN PRL.MODIFIED_BY_AGENT_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS DELETE_FLG, POH.PO_HEADER_ID AS POH_PO_HEADER_ID, POL.PO_LINE_ID AS POL_PO_LINE_ID, PRH.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID AS PORH_REQUISITION_HEADER_ID FROM POC.PO_REQUISITION_LINES_ALL PRL JOIN POC.PO_REQUISITION_HEADERS_ALL PRH ON PRL.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID = PRH.REQUISITION_HEADER_ID LEFT JOIN POC.PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL PLL ON PRL.LINE_LOCATION_ID = PLL.LINE_LOCATION_ID LEFT JOIN POC.PO_LINES_ALL POL ON PLL.PO_LINE_ID = POL.PO_LINE_ID LEFT JOIN POC.PO_HEADERS_ALL POH ON POL.PO_HEADER_ID = POH.PO_HEADER_ID LEFT JOIN POC.PO_RELEASES_ALL POR ON PLL.PO_RELEASE_ID = POR.PO_RELEASE_ID

_notes: RESOLVED (container DevContainer id 518): engineName=168_AN (confirmed via list_engines), folderName=Dataflow/0e4b8c19-6a14-43bd-9c14-23f421b9971e (confirmed via list_folders; WorkingSession folder deliberately not used, matching GTAS precedent). dataSourceName JDBC_1=W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_FS (data_source_id 4480802), JDBC_2=OLTP_PO_REQUISITION_LINES (data_source_id 4480803) -- both confirmed registered Oracle sources via list_data_sources. No naming collision found via list_dataflows (an unrelated pre-existing HHS_SIL_PurchaseRequisitionLinesFact_TestCase lives in WorkingSession folder, different name/folder).

SCOPE: covers INTEGRATION_ID derivation + composite PK (INTEGRATION_ID, X_CUSTOM), the LINE_AMT/CANCELLED_LINE_AMT MATCHING_BASIS branch, and the PO_APPROVED_ON_DT/PO_SUBMIT_ON_DT/PO_CREATION_METHOD_ID/PO_REVISIONS release-vs-header branch (PO_RELEASE_ID IS NULL).

OUT OF SCOPE (flagged, not silently dropped): STD_COST_AMT/UNIT_STD_COST currency-converted standard cost (LOC_TO_DOC via MPLT_CURCY_CONVERSION_RATES_All + LKP_STD_COST against W_STANDARD_COST_G -- mapplet internals not fully traced this session, add as follow-up once traced). The $$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE 4-branch incremental/CDC SELECT logic in the Source Qualifier override is a run-to-run extraction concern, not testable via a single-snapshot DataCompare.

DATASOURCE_NUM_ID is a static mapping-parameter value ($$DATASOURCE_NUM_ID) and X_CUSTOM is hardcoded '0' -- both declared PRIMARY KEY on the target but neither differentiates rows within one run; DATASOURCE_NUM_ID is ignoreColumn:true for that reason (same treatment as the GTAS test case's analogous column).

DEPLOYED (container DevContainer id 518, dataflowId d5569904-3970-4d41-a61c-4a69adb9b474, run 330248): schema-qualified all Oracle tables with POC. prefix (bare table names failed with ORA-00942 -- confirmed via list_dataflows precedent that this platform's staging/EBS tables live under schema POC, not the connection's default). Corrected DELETE_FLG from a hardcoded 'N' to the real branch found in the workflow XML (Exp_W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_FS_Integration_Id's EXT_DELETE_FLAG: IIF(MODIFIED_BY_AGENT_FLAG='Y','Y','N') once INTEGRATION_ID/DATASOURCE_NUM_ID are non-null) -- the original hardcode was a review-agent oversight caught before running. Removed MODIFIED_BY_AGENT_FLAG as a standalone column since it does not exist on the target table W_PURCH_RQSTN_LINE_FS (confirmed via sample data) -- it is only an input to DELETE_FLG's derivation, not a passthrough target field.

X_CUSTOM removed from the unique key (run 330248): the target's real X_CUSTOM values are synthetic placeholder text ('X_CUSTOM_N', one per demo row) that do not match any derivable source expression -- confirmed via the workflow XML's own connector (SQ_BCI_PURCH_RQLNS's X_CUSTOM field is wired FROM PO_LINE_LOCATIONS_ALL.ENCUMBERED_FLAG, a Y/N flag, not a stable identifier), and via this demo container's synthetic seeded data pattern (every ID-shaped column across every table in this container follows a 'PLACEHOLDER_N' or row-number pattern unrelated to real join semantics). INTEGRATION_ID alone is the practically discriminating key, matching the GTAS precedent's finding about DATASOURCE_NUM_ID/X_CUSTOM.
